title: Utility Easement Trade Approved
summary:
*   **Quick Special Session:** A brief, 5-minute special meeting of the city's governing body was convened to address a single item.
*   **Utility Easement Swap:** Council members voted to release an existing utility easement.
*   **Secure Alternate Easement:** An alternative easement was approved, featuring a letter of credit for financial security.
*   **Unanimous Vote Amidst Absences:** The resolution passed 4-0, despite the Mayor and two other members being absent.

RELEASE OF UTILITY EASEMENT
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Urdy's second, adopted
a resolution releasing a utility easement and accepted an alternate easement with a
provision for letter of credit security. (4-0 Vote, Mayor Cooksey, Councilmembers Shipman
and Humphrey absent) ADJOURNMENT Council adjourned its meeting at 4:05 p.m.
